chunks: Yet in His benevolence He made you night and day that you may rest and seek His bounty during them, and haply maybe grateful.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of night and day according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the balanced rhythm of human life, where night serves as a time for physical and spiritual restoration (sukun) while day facilitates active engagement with the world (ibtigha). Scholars emphasize that this duality is not merely functional but a divine test to cultivate gratitude (shukr) through recognizing the interdependence of rest and labor. The verse underscores the concept of 'rahmah' (mercy) as the underlying principle of cosmic order, inviting believers to reflect on the purposeful design of time.
